stories.title: A visitor understands what the app does from the home page
acceptance: Within 5 seconds the visitor can say what the app is for
There is one obvious primary action
stories.notes: No steps or assertions: the run opens every path in surfaces, screenshots each, and the persona-tester judges the acceptance criteria.

stories.title: A visitor can start sign-up from the home page
acceptance: The sign-up form asks only for an email

stories.title: A returning user can search and open a result with the keyboard
acceptance: Results appear without a full page reload

stories.title: An empty account explains what to do next
acceptance: The empty state says what will appear here and offers the first action
stories.notes: NOT_BUILT: skipped until it is built, unless named with --story.

stories.title: A member can open a group's page
acceptance: The group page shows its name and members
stories.notes: /groups/:id is a route pattern: qa.params fills it with a real id, so both surfaces open. Without it the row is inconclusive (needs a concrete URL).
